name: gang-bruiser
theme: the street gangs of a near-future city at night, the figure shown alone on a plain light grey studio backdrop, no street, no rain, no signs, no scenery
description: A heavy-set street gang enforcer who fights with his fists, a big broad-shouldered man in a black quilted nylon bomber jacket with a torn sleeve and one strip of dull orange reflective tape, a dark knitted beanie, a black cloth face mask over nose and mouth, heavy fingerless leather gloves with steel knuckle studs, baggy grey sweatpants and heavy black boots; empty-handed, both arms raised straight out to the sides
